subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises all vowel and consonant blends learnt so far

show.line: Two consonants make a blend. You hear both! bl, as in blue. st, as in star. fr, as in frog.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with bl, as in blue?
Listen to the end. Nest. Which blend ends the word?
This word starts with fr. It is green and hops. Say it.
bl, st or fr? Sort the pictures by their first blend.
Listen. s, p, oo, n. Tap the word.
Which word ends with mp, as in jump?

hints: Say the first two sounds slowly. Can you hear both?
A blend is two letters, two sounds, said close together.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with st.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Snake starts with sn. Star starts with st.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. st, st, star. Star starts with st!

parent_line: Can hear and read consonant blends like bl, st and fr.
